label: Верить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for верить (to believe).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. Верить is imperfective and takes -ю for 'верю'. It governs the dative person 'тебе', the standard pattern for trusting someone.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Веришь' shows the -ишь ending. 'В чудеса' shows the в + accusative pattern for believing in something.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Верит' takes the -ит ending. It governs the dative 'каждому слову', meaning to trust what is said.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Верим' uses the -им ending. 'В нашу победу' shows the в + accusative of faith in an outcome.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Верят' closes the present set with the -ят ending. The dative 'слухам' marks what is or is not believed.
Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Верил' is the masculine -л past of верить. The perfective partner поверить marks a single moment of coming to believe.
Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Верила' adds the feminine -ла ending. The dative 'людям' is the standard object, and 'всегда' marks a lasting trait.
Strategic focus: Past, plural. 'Верили' is the plural -ли past, shared by all genders. 'В добрые сказки' shows belief in something with в + accusative.

missions.phrase: Верь в себя и не сдавайся.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Верь' is the informal command of верить. 'В себя' is a fixed idiom meaning to have self-confidence.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Верить' stays in the dictionary form after evaluative 'трудно'. The dative 'обещаниям' names what is hard to believe.
